verdict.rationale: smolagents is a pip-installable library that runs agents in a few lines of code. It supports local `transformers` or `ollama` models, a rebuilt `LocalPythonExecutor`, and Docker sandboxing, so the whole stack can run on your own infrastructure. Hub sharing (`push_to_hub`/`from_hub`) is optional rather than required. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or guide for fully offline/air-gapped production deployment, and independent hands-on confirmation of running with no Hugging Face dependency.
